faq.q1: How do I choose the right plan?
faq.a1: Free is for trial use, Standard fits light production access, Business supports stable team traffic, Channel fits high-throughput distribution and sub-accounts, and Custom is for dedicated lines, branding, and deep integrations.
faq.a2: We accept Alipay, WeChat Pay, and bank transfers. Enterprise clients can pay by corporate transfer. Annual billing charges 10 months and includes 2 extra months.
faq.a3: You can upgrade at any time with prorated pricing. Downgrades or moves to a custom plan can be scheduled for the next billing cycle with support assistance.
